specs.Shutter speed range: Still images:1/4000 to 30 seconds, Bulb, Movies: 1/4000 to 1/4 (1/3 steps), up to 1/50 in AUTO mode (up to 1/25 in Auto slow shutter mode)
specs.Brightness adjustment: Manual (5 steps between -2 and +2), Sunny Weather mode
specs.Flash modes: Flash Off, Autoflash, Fill-Flash, Slow Sync., Rear Sync., Red-eye reduction (on/off selectable), Wireless control, Hi-speed sync
specs.Shooting modes: Single Shooting, Continuous shooting (Hi+/Hi/Mid/Lo selectable), Self-timer, Self-timer (Cont.)
specs.Exposure compensation: Plus/Minus 5.0 EV (1/3 EV, 1/2 EV steps selectable)

features: Sensor: APS-C CMOS sensor with 24.2 MP (high resolution for large prints and image cropping)
Wide sensitivity range of ISO 100–32000, expanded up to 51200 for stills. Even when you're shooting at high sensitivity in dim lighting, excellent low-noise performance ensures high-quality images.
Image Processor: Bionz X 4D focus with fast hybrid AF and 425 phase detection autofocus points (important for speed and accuracy of autofocus and burst photography)
Fast Hybrid AF brings high speed, accuracy and tracking performance to meet the stringent autofocus demands of 4K movies.
Connectivity: WiFi, NFC and Bluetooth built-in (useful for remotely controlling your camera and transferring pictures wirelessly as you shoot)
The touch tracking feature provides smooth, continuous focus tracking of your subject, and it can be activated with a simple touch of the display screen.
